about: Which picture in the repository is which character, for app.workflows.passes.character_references (2026-10-11). The Owner: «Cauta pozele caracterelor/agentilor. Sa le putem include in bible ca la serial sa stim dupa ce caractere sa ne luam.» Each entry maps a bible's canonical_name to a PNG, relative to the repository, with the SHA-256 the picture was verified at by eye against the anchors in Agents ID and Bible/CHARACTER_BIBLES.md. The watchdog copies a verified file into the studio's media storage, makes it a MediaAsset and fills the bible's empty 'portrait' slot, once; a file whose SHA-256 no longer matches is reported and never registered, so a replaced picture needs a new look and a new hash here. Nothing here locks an identity or fills another slot: the Owner decides whether to lock the looks (then a missing reference blocks a scene by design) and whether to buy full_body/front/side/back through his press.
verified_by: read by eye in a Claude session: every sheet is titled with its character's name and its anchors match the bible (see matched_on); each crop was then viewed whole and its cut edges at 8x, to confirm that no text, quote, label or logo of the sheet lies inside it
pictures_are: head-and-shoulders crops of the PORTRAIT panel of each character-bible sheet (hand-drawn 2D style, CHARACTER_BIBLES.md variant A), cut with Pillow from the sheet named in cropped_from at crop_box, no resampling. The whole sheets carried the title, labels, the handwritten quote and the AMN-AI logos and slogans, which an image model given the sheet as a face reference draws into the face; the crops carry none of it, only the face, the hair and what the quote's corner left of the shoulders. They fix who each character is; they are not in the serial's rendering (config/serial_series_look.json asks for stylised cinematic 3D and avoids flat 2D), so a clean set in the series' look remains the paid route's to produce.
crop_box_is: [left, top, right, bottom] in the sheet's pixels, right and bottom exclusive (PIL.Image.crop); the crop's pixels are [right - left, bottom - top]
